title: Venice coffeehouse
summary: The Venice coffeehouse is a café located in Venice, Italy, which sells several types of coffee, alcoholic beverages, and cakes. Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit worked here for a short time as they were trying to earn money for plane tickets to Egypt.

sections.heading: History
sections.text: While Lok, Sophie, and Cherit were working here, one customer complained about their service because his double cappuccino was too cold for his tastes. Lok used a Boltflare spell on the drink, making the customer burn his tongue. The two were fired shortly thereafter. [All Work and No Pay]

full_text:
The Venice coffeehouse is a café located in Venice, Italy, which sells several types of coffee, alcoholic beverages, and cakes. Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit worked here for a short time as they were trying to earn money for plane tickets to Egypt. [All Work and No Pay]

== History==
While Lok, Sophie, and Cherit were working here, one customer complained about their service because his double cappuccino was too cold for his tastes. Lok used a Boltflare spell on the drink, making the customer burn his tongue. The two were fired shortly thereafter. [All Work and No Pay]
